user.title: Set up USB Android Debug Bridge
user.description: Discover USB-connected Android phones on this Home Assistant host. Enable USB debugging on each phone and ensure Home Assistant Core can access the USB devices. Phones are scanned every 30 seconds.

abort.already_configured: The USB ADB hub is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one USB ADB hub can be configured.

init.title: Default phone
init.description: Choose the phone that actions use when they are called without a serial. The list shows every phone discovered so far, with its model once the phone has authorized USB debugging. Leave empty for no default: actions without a serial then work only while exactly one phone is connected.

abort.no_phones: No phone has been discovered yet. Connect a phone with USB debugging enabled, wait for it to appear, and try again.

adb_unauthorized.title: Phone {serial} has not authorized USB debugging
adb_unauthorized.description: The phone `{serial}` is connected over USB but does not trust this Home Assistant host, so actions will fail. Unlock the phone, run the `android_debug_bridge_usb.shell` action with the serial `{serial}` (for example with the command `id`), and accept **Allow USB debugging?** on the phone, ticking **Always allow from this computer**. This message disappears once the phone answers.
